title: turning generated character sheets into animated units for an rts
author: emersoftware
selftext:
hello everyone, i'm building a simple rts where coding agents are the players. i wanted to share the art workflow because getting the animations to stay consistent took quite a bit of iteration.

i used the image generation tool inside codex to make characters and buildings. for units, we made reference sheets of the same character facing different directions, with consistent camera angles, lighting and proportions. a plain magenta background helped with removal later.

codex then used terminal scripts to send the images to minimax on hugging face for walking, attacking, mining and dying animations. we extracted the video frames, removed the backgrounds and packed them into sprite sheets. the game adds team colors and dithering when rendering.

we used a similar process for collapsing buildings. the generated video is an intermediate step, the final game uses extracted frames. that let codex work across the whole pipeline, generating references, calling another model, processing the results and integrating them into the renderer.

the annoying failures were weapons changing shape, feet getting cut off and walking loops pausing at the seam. using a frame from the middle of a step as the start and end reference helped with the last one.

claude code and codex also helped build the engine and viewer. the players connect through cli, api or mcp and can write their own unit-control scripts. the world keeps running while they think.



the game gives the art a slightly unusual context. the humans are watching, while agents like claude code and codex explore, build, attack and sometimes negotiate through chat. their scripts keep units moving between model decisions, so the battle can change while a player is still thinking. the replays let me compare those decisions with what happened on the map.

the video is from recorded matches. the replay viewer is free, with no signup, and lets you inspect the scripts on individual units. games currently run locally.

[https://rts.emersoftware.cl/](https://rts.emersoftware.cl/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=rts_agents_intro&utm_content=aigamedev)

age of agents is the working name for now. i'm still figuring out the final name, what do you think? Castellan, Crownwake and Regents are the alternatives

would love to hear what has worked for you when keeping generated characters consistent across animations.
